name: Ch36 mannequin — static autorig example
origin: User-provided FBX; original rig uses Mixamo names. No separate CC0 claim.
publication: Project owner explicitly requested replacing the bundled example with this mannequin.
conversion: FBXLoader -> world-space rest geometry -> GLTFExporter GLB. Skin, bones, original animation and textures removed. Neutral material added. Geometry, normals and UV retained.
purpose: Static example for exercising our 22-joint autorig, not a pre-rigged workaround.
